# KB syntax golden cases — AdGuard DNS filter syntax
# Format: each rule line is tested; expectation is in the trailing comment after # (exp:...)
# exp values: keep_block / keep_allow / drop_comment / drop_css / drop_url /
#             drop_unrecognized / modstrip (rule kept, modifiers stripped) /
#             keep_mod (rule kept, specific modifier preserved)
||ads.example.com^                    # exp:keep_block
@@||ads.example.com^                  # exp:keep_allow
||*.example.com^                      # exp:keep_block
0.0.0.0 ads.example.com               # exp:keep_block
127.0.0.1 localhost                   # exp:drop_localhost
example.com                           # exp:keep_block
/ads-[a-z]+/                          # exp:keep_block
@@/track-[a-z]+/                      # exp:keep_allow
||x.com^$important                    # exp:keep_mod:important
||x.com^$badfilter                    # exp:keep_mod:badfilter
||x.com^$dnsrewrite=1.2.3.4           # exp:keep_mod:dnsrewrite
||x.com^$dnstype=A                    # exp:keep_mod:dnstype
||x.com^$denyallow=y.com              # exp:keep_mod:denyallow
||x.com^$client=1.2.3.4               # exp:keep_mod:client
||x.com^$ctag=android                 # exp:keep_mod:ctag
||x.com^$respgeo=CN                   # exp:keep_mod:respgeo
||x.com^$removeparam=utm               # exp:unknown_mod (per spec whole-line drop)
||x.com^$csp=script-src               # exp:unknown_mod
||x.com^$third-party                  # exp:unknown_mod
! a comment                           # exp:drop_comment
# a comment                            # exp:drop_comment
example.com##.ad                      # exp:drop_css
https://example.com/path              # exp:drop_url
|example.com^                         # exp:anchor (leading |)
example.com|                          # exp:anchor (trailing |)
||example.org^$important              # exp:keep_mod:important
